notes.title: Beautiful
notes.content:
[h3]New command: nyx[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/6ZFC774/Nyx2.png[/img]
Nyx performs encryption and decryption for the algorithms it supports.

[b]Kasiski examination[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/7428D92/Kasiski.gif[/img]
Nyx performs a coincidence analysis on a ciphertext with an unknown key length and then attacks to crack the ciphertext according to the key length returned as a result of the analysis. This process is subject to restrictions.

[h3]New command: neeko[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/gSrpnnZ/Neeko-Command2.gif[/img]
The cute little kitty neeko can accompany you through the challenging process of CHAQS.

[h3]New command: mousemove[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/8PMbG5z/Mousemove-Command.gif[/img]
Moves the mouse cursor to the corresponding coordinates on the screen also performs left click, right click and left double click actions for mouse. Runs on native os.

[h3]New command: checksum[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/wBCy2Vf/Checksum-Command.png[/img]
Computes the md5 or sha256 checksum of a file. Computes md5 by default.

[h3]New command: alias[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/cxc1CsQ/Alias-Command.png[/img]
Assigns alias to the command.

[h3]New command: mandb[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/sqFZqPZ/Mandb-Command.png[/img]
Allows user-created manual pages located under the /chaqs/usr/share/man directory to override the default manual pages.

[h3]New command: history[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/SJdPjv0/History-Command.png[/img]
Shows up to 10 last commands executed

[h3]New command: ps[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/9Wgz5ML/Ps-Command.png[/img]
Reports a snapshot of the current processes. Subject to restrictions.

[h3]New commands: kill & killall[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rMVprmP/KillAll.gif[/img]
Kill sends a terminate signal to the process with the specified process id. Killall sends a terminate signal to all processes, but bypasses the terminal. 

[h3]New command: apropos[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/jHH8pR6/Apropos-Command.png[/img]
The apropos command shows the manual descriptions that contain any of the word specified by the user.

[h3]New command: factor[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/9vdfrt6/Factor-Command.png[/img]
Prints the prime factors of specified integer number.

[h3]New command: tac[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/GP1vzMY/Tac-Command.png[/img]
Concatenates and prints files in reverse

[h3]New command: xclip[/h3]
xclip reads a file in CHAQS and copies it into the system copy buffer and pastes the value from the system copy buffer into the terminal input field.

[b]New option: waveform[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Gsy7sD8/Audiodecoder-Waveform3.png[/img]
Audiodecoder can render waveforms of audio files and save the results as a PNG

[b]Merged command: base[/b]
Commands for 32, 58, 64 and 85 base representation of binary data have been merged under the base command.

[u][i]Other updates are below.[/i][/u]
[list]
[*] Added sfc(fsck), challengers, cowsay commands.
[*] The Piet programming language interpreter has been revised and the process has been made asynchronous.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Shark to analyse a pcap file 3 times.
[*] Fixed an issue where the autocomplete method would not notice the status when switching between terminal tabs.
[*] Added an option to the menu that automatically copies the last output to the system copy buffer.
[*] Imported files are no longer automatically converted at startup.
[*] The structure of the Terminal has been revised.
[*] The terminal scrolling sensitivity can be adjusted.
[*] Clicking on the output area to give focus to the input area was not possible as it conflicted with highlighting, it is now possible.
[*] Revised the linq2chaqs command.
[*] Added commands that are not listed but may be functional.
[/list]

notes.title: Accumulated silence of the green
notes.content:
[h3]Command guide panel[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/3FVV2jm/CHAQS-Help-And-Guide-Panel.gif[/img]
The command guide indicator on the taskbar provides one-line manual page description of terminal commands. Now you can quickly search for commands from this panel without having to go to the menu interface.
[h3]New command: translate[/h3]
The translate command requires an internet connection. You can use it to translate one language to another if you need it.
[list]
[*]Terminal's autocomplete functionality has been revised.
[/list]
[u][i]The following are the updates that have been silently made since the last regular update.[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]Added ipconfig command.
[*]The root directory has been revised.
[*]Fonts revised.
[*]Added asynchronous parameter for import and extract commands.
[*]The case of text overflowing in the quick note widget has been fixed.
[*]Notepad revised
[*]Minor changes have been made to the menu.
[*]Minor UI improvements have been made.
[*]Provide command can now modify default api calls.
[*]The tab key can cycle through selectable items in the setup panel.
[*]The new game button in the opening scene will ask for confirmation if there is a saved game.
[*]The vast majority of Challenge 13 Regex's tasks have been changed. Existing correct answers will not be affected.
[*]Refresh library buttons in the music player, video player and photo gallery have been made asynchronous.
[*]Fixed situation where find command could not find all files due to / prefix.
[*]The following commands have been revised.
    mkdir, mvdir, renamedir, rmdir, trash
[*]Code editor, music player, quad, 2048 have been revised.
[*]Context menus and settings window have been redesigned.
[*]The search panel has been redesigned.
[/list]

notes.title: Improvements winking to the windows
notes.content:
[h3]Snap layouts[/h3]
Snap layouts are a series of predefined zones where you can place each app for quick access. Snap layouts help users arrange applications in five different ways.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/qgC9K63/CHAQS-Snap-Layouts.png[/img]
As shown in the animation below, you can access this feature from the panel that opens when you drag any application to the middle-upper part of the screen. This feature is disabled by default.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/G05fPZP/CHAQS-Snap-Layouts.gif[/img]

[h3]Keyboard hook[/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/yVrGhbX/CHAQS-Keyboard-Hook.gif[/img]
The keyboard hook allows for easy switching between programs in CHAQS and disables the operating system's [b]native[/b] Alt+Tab combination while CHAQS is running. In case the keyboard hook is active, you cannot use the alt and tab keys of the operating system in any way. Can be activated once per session. This feature is disabled by default.

[u][i]Other updates are below[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]Browser+ app has been revised and a situation has been noticed. If the plugin server file needed by the Browser+ application is somehow deleted, this situation will be displayed in the program. If this file is deleted, the Browser+ application is no longer accessible.
[*]The entire interface has been revised due to the Snap layouts feature. Apart from this, the positions of the content of the pages required for the challenges opened via the Web Browser used in the in-CHAQS interaction may be affected.
[*]Since it was seen in the two reports sent by the players that the players could not pass the invitation stage, when the terminal is opened for the second time in this scene, an additional message will be printed to the terminal.
[*]The [b]contact widget[/b] has been added to the CHAQS as the report a problem button does not allow the player to send an additional message. Only one contact request can be made per session.
[*]Revised the case where the [b]wget[/b] command could not name the file correctly even if the file content is retrieved when the corresponding header value is [b]txt/plain[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug with the wget command not terminating its functionality. The download limit has been increased to 50 MB.
[*]Added 12 hour format option
[*]4 of the default backgrounds have been changed.
[*]The interface of Pwsh+, Native and Stegoimage programs has been reorganized.
[*]Removed the video link in the message sent to new challengers.
[*]The [b]transition color[/b] option has been added to the interface command.. For this option to be active, the particle color option [b]must be[/b] set otherwise it won't work even if it appears active.
[*]First name can no longer contain spaces.
[*]Improved the process for password recovery.
[*]Browser+ and Pwsh+ programs will no longer be on the desktop of new challengers by default.
[/list]

notes.title: Great and unfortunate things
notes.content:
Improved the [b]fix[/b] parameter of the [b]challenges[/b] command added to the game by releasing a quick update regarding the issue where a player completed the 7th Challenge (Charon) but the game crashed during this time and could not move on to the next challenge despite answering all the tasks correctly.

Although the probability of encountering this situation is low considering that it occurs for the first time, it is still not zero. Therefore, considering that there are too many commands in the game, a person who may encounter this situation may not know this solution, the method will automatically check when the game is restarted.

A notification will be sent if problems are found during the execution of the relevant command or the check at the start of the game.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/kgKmv9K/CHAQS-Problem-Solved.gif[/img]

[h3]Callbacks[/h3]
If none of the automatic api call files located in the api folder under the Documents directory return a successful result, this will be shown in the relevant panel.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/wcY3NSc/CHAQS-APIS.gif[/img]

[h3]Stage[/h3]
If any achievements you earned in offline mode were not synced or if something like the example above occurred and you were unable to unlock the achievement, now they will sync when you are online.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xhC8qZm/CHAQSAchievement-Anim.gif[/img]

[h3]Offensive security[/h3]
As a result of the fix parameter, which was added to the challenges command by necessity, some precautions have been taken for the security of the challenges.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/XZrJX1f/CHAQS-Approved3.gif[/img]

[h3]Correctness percentage of the answer[/h3]
An option has been added to the menu so that you can see the percentage of correctness of your answer for the tasks in the challenge. Runs 3 times for each session and then turn off.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QF72UyW.png[/img]

[h3]Reporting a problem in-game[/h3]
A problem reporting button has been added to the Help and Guide page that will allow you to send all the necessary information. You will receive a notification in the opening scene if your report is responded to.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iMHkbGY.gif[/img]

[h3]New command: interface[/h3]
[b]interface[/b] command to allow you to interact with the menu settings from the terminal.

[h3]Additional[/h3]
[list]
[*]Cronjob has been made optional due to the processing load. To activate the cronjob, you need to activate the relevant option in the menu.
[*]Improvements have been made for the security of challenges.
[*]Added some hidden functions for possible situations.
[/list]

This is the last update for CHAQS that brings new features.

[u][i]Apart from the above, the improvements that were carried out quietly without the need to publish a patch note are below.[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]The task assistant option has been added to the menu to help the players. If enabled, the help icon will appear next to the tasks that are deemed appropriate to help.
[*]Edited answer key for some tasks to include alternative answers.
[*]Fixed an issue where the corner edges of the top image in the challenge window were disproportionately rounded.
[*]Made some UI improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Revisions
notes.content:
In-game ssh and nc connections were causing terminal tabs to be confused. This situation has been reconsidered.

The file explorer's renaming and file deletion functions have been adjusted to work in harmony with the properties window.

Reminder app made functional

Map and weather services has been updated.

Added completing local directory feature to terminal. If used as the first argument (without any precommands), command names may conflict with directory and file names.

The wget command can download files from the internet. The file size limit is 10mb.
